item.description:
Beta build, made from code 40372aa4.

  • Know when a Mac can't be reached. A Mac running this version that is online but can't take a connection from outside its own network now says so on its tile, with the reason.
  • Your Mac's reachability in Settings. The Sharing tab says whether this Mac is reachable from anywhere or only on its own network, and why.
  • Sleeping Macs no longer hold a dead connection. A Mac that wakes briefly in the background while asleep no longer opens a connection it can't answer.

Beta build, made from code 7b54a9c5. The first published build since 95.

  • Tap-to-pair and Unpair. Pair your own devices with a tap. Unpair removes a pairing on both sides, and pairings stay with your account.
  • Faster sessions over the internet. More sessions connect directly instead of through the relay, at 60 frames per second, and typing and the mouse take the fast path with a reliable one behind it.
  • Better sound and picture between Macs. Compressed audio that travels with the video, HEVC where both Macs support it, and quicker recovery after a lost frame.

Beta build. Replaces build 94, which was withdrawn before release.

  • Fixes a crash during a session. A timing calculation on the drawing path could overflow and terminate the app after a few minutes of streaming. Found in testing; build 94 was never published.
  • Hardens six more places with the same flaw. The same unsafe time arithmetic appeared elsewhere, including one fed by a value the remote host sends back. All now handled safely.
  • No change to video decoding. The decode path is byte-for-byte identical to build 93.
